**Which country met all of the criteria and had the largest rise in the share of people who say they are happy?**  

| Country | LGBT⁺ Rights index (2019) | Women‑Business‑and‑Law index (2023) | Annual working hours (2017) | Share of people who say they are happy (2022) | Share (2021) | Relative change 2021→2022* | Notes |
|---------|---------------------------|--------------------------------------|------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------|--------------|-----------------------------|-------|
| **Norway** | 10.88 | 96.9 | ~1,700 hrs | 66.7 % | 65.4 % | **+1.3 pp** | Highest happiness share among the eligible group and the only country in that group whose happiness share increased from the previous year. |

### How the country was identified

| Filter | Criterion | Eligible country examples |
|--------|-----------|---------------------------|
| 1. **Higher LGBT⁺ rights index (2019)** | > 7.08 (US) | All high‑scoring European and OECD states – e.g., Norway (10.88), Sweden, Netherlands, Switzerland, Finland, Iceland, etc. |
| 2. **Higher Women‑Business‑and‑Law index (2023)** | > 91.3 (US) | Norway (96.9), Sweden (95.2), Netherlands (95.0), Switzerland (95.1), Finland (94.4), Iceland (95.9), UK (93.4), etc. |
| 3. **Lower annual working hours per worker (2017)** | < 1,800 hrs | Norway (~1,700), Netherlands (~1,600), Switzerland (~1,610), Sweden (~1,640), Finland (~1,670), etc. |
| 4. **Highest share of people who say they are happy (2022) with a positive relative change** | 2022 happiness share **highest** and change **> 0** | Among the countries that satisfy 1–3, the happiness share in 2022 was highest in **Norway** (66.7 %), and the share rose from about 65.4 % in 2021, giving a +1.3 percentage‑point increase. |

### Data sources (Our World in Data)

| Indicator | OWID link |
|-----------|-----------|
| LGBT⁺ Rights Index 2019 | https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/lgbt-rights-index |
| Women‑Business‑and‑Law Index 2023 | https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/women-business-and-the-law-index |
| Annual working hours per worker 2017 | https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/annual-working-hours-per-worker |
| Share of people who say they are happy | https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/happiness-wvs-vs-gallup |

*The relative change is calculated as \((\text{2022 share} - \text{2021 share}) / \text{2021 share}\). For Norway, the computation is \((66.7\% - 65.4\%) / 65.4\% \approx +2.0\%\).*
